summary: Dillard's filed an 8-K reporting completion of a merger with W.D. Company, Inc. (WDC), a family holding company owning ~3.99M Class B and ~41K Class A shares—effectively collapsing a dual-class structure into direct holdings for family shareholders. No price per share or premium; each WDC shareholder received their pro rata share of the Dillard's stock and WDC's cash. The board approved the merger without an outside advisor. The move simplifies governance and eliminates the holding company layer. Watch for any tax implications or subsequent liquidity events from former WDC shareholders.
